user.title: Set up Marstek Venus E
user.description: Find your Marstek Venus E and connect it to Home Assistant.

discovery.title: Discovering devices
discovery.description: Scanning the local network for Marstek devices…

select_device.title: Select device
select_device.description: Found {device_count} device(s). Select a device, retry discovery, or enter an IP address manually.

manual_ip.title: Enter device IP address
manual_ip.description: No device was discovered automatically. Enter the IP address of your Marstek Venus E manually.

clear_schedules.title: Manage schedules with Home Assistant
clear_schedules.description: Home Assistant can optionally manage the manual charging and discharging schedules. Enable this only if all ten schedule slots (0–9) stored on the device should be disabled.

data.clear_schedules: Manage schedules with Home Assistant – delete all schedules stored on the device

data_description.clear_schedules: Disables all ten existing manual schedule slots. Leave unchecked to keep the stored schedules unchanged.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the device. Check the IP address and port.
error.no_device_selected: Select a device or enter an IP address.
error.clear_failed: The schedules could not be cleared. The device may be unavailable.

abort.schedule_failed: The schedule could not be saved.
abort.cannot_retrieve_schedules: The existing schedules could not be retrieved.

configure_manual_mode.title: Configure manual schedule
configure_manual_mode.description: Set up a charging or discharging schedule. The device API cannot read schedules back.

data_description.time_slot: Select one of the ten available schedule slots.
data_description.start_time: Time at which the schedule starts.
data_description.end_time: Time at which the schedule ends.
data_description.days: Days on which the schedule is active.
data_description.power: Negative values charge the battery; positive values discharge it.
data_description.enable: Enables this schedule slot on the device.

configure_update_interval.title: Configure update intervals
configure_update_interval.description: Set separate polling intervals for power values and operating-mode/CT data.

configure_operating_modes.title: Select available operating modes
configure_operating_modes.description: Choose the modes shown by the operating-mode entity. Storage mode keeps the battery around 50% using hysteresis.

data_description.enabled_modes: Select at least one operating mode.

configure_solar_surplus.title: Configure solar output
configure_solar_surplus.description: Select the Home Assistant power sensor used by automatic winter operation and configure its time-weighted thresholds.
